purpose: Independent service review for official City of Ekurhuleni public parcel-map evidence; runtime qualification is intentionally held for serial review.
assessment: The first-party City of Ekurhuleni GIS ArcGIS service returned safe Polygon geometry from the unchanged WUP point and a bounded envelope. The envelope response was transfer-limited; this does not establish citywide coverage.
